fact_text: The budget withdrew the federal excise duty, which the All Karachi Realtors Association had asked to be removed.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Budget 2026 is Shaping the Real Estate & Construction Industry | Pakistan Property Playbook' (YouTube, 2025-06-15)

fact_text: The government announced a financing package for middle and lower-middle income buyers at the lowest rates, with details to be announced by the State Bank of Pakistan.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Budget 2026 is Shaping the Real Estate & Construction Industry | Pakistan Property Playbook' (YouTube, 2025-06-15)

fact_text: The budget raised withholding tax on property sellers and reduced it for purchasers.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Budget 2026 is Shaping the Real Estate & Construction Industry | Pakistan Property Playbook' (YouTube, 2025-06-15)

fact_text: Under tax section 114C as described, a property buyer must prove eligible-buyer status before purchase, and non-filers cannot buy a home at all.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Budget 2026 is Shaping the Real Estate & Construction Industry | Pakistan Property Playbook' (YouTube, 2025-06-15)

fact_text: Even tax filers must have an FBR SAO officer confirm they have cash, gold, silver or other means to buy property before the purchase.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Budget 2026 is Shaping the Real Estate & Construction Industry | Pakistan Property Playbook' (YouTube, 2025-06-15)

fact_text: About 40% of the roughly 58 lakh tax filers declared zero income in their returns.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Budget 2026 is Shaping the Real Estate & Construction Industry | Pakistan Property Playbook' (YouTube, 2025-06-15)

fact_text: Realtors argue the eligibility rule will collapse the property market, push investment money into Dubai real estate, and deter buyers from an FBR approval process.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Budget 2026 is Shaping the Real Estate & Construction Industry | Pakistan Property Playbook' (YouTube, 2025-06-15)

fact_text: Hassan Bakhshi, chairman of the Association of Builders and Developers, said the eligibility rule is not an IMF requirement and goes against Pakistan's constitution.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Budget 2026 is Shaping the Real Estate & Construction Industry | Pakistan Property Playbook' (YouTube, 2025-06-15)

fact_text: Bakhshi said the industry will lobby at all levels, including the army chief, the SIFC and the government, and will go to court if the rule is not reversed.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Budget 2026 is Shaping the Real Estate & Construction Industry | Pakistan Property Playbook' (YouTube, 2025-06-15)

fact_text: Bakhshi said Pakistan's housing backlog is about 12 million homes.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Budget 2026 is Shaping the Real Estate & Construction Industry | Pakistan Property Playbook' (YouTube, 2025-06-15)

fact_text: Bakhshi said Pakistan needs about 6 to 7 lakh new homes a year, while only part of that is built.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Budget 2026 is Shaping the Real Estate & Construction Industry | Pakistan Property Playbook' (YouTube, 2025-06-15)

fact_text: Bakhshi estimated that about 2 lakh of the new homes built each year are in unauthorised areas.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Budget 2026 is Shaping the Real Estate & Construction Industry | Pakistan Property Playbook' (YouTube, 2025-06-15)

fact_text: Bakhshi said Pakistan's young population needs homes, and that policymakers must choose between planned housing and informal settlements.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Budget 2026 is Shaping the Real Estate & Construction Industry | Pakistan Property Playbook' (YouTube, 2025-06-15)

fact_text: Bakhshi said factories in allied industries such as cement, steel, marble, tiles and wiring are not viable at 30 to 50% of production.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Budget 2026 is Shaping the Real Estate & Construction Industry | Pakistan Property Playbook' (YouTube, 2025-06-15)

fact_text: Bakhshi argued allied industries produce only when buyers buy, so construction demand is the trigger for cement and steel output.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Budget 2026 is Shaping the Real Estate & Construction Industry | Pakistan Property Playbook' (YouTube, 2025-06-15)

fact_text: The builders' body proposed a per-square-foot tax on developers so the state collects directly, arguing that otherwise collectors and taxpayers split the money and the state gets only 30-40%.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Budget 2026 is Shaping the Real Estate & Construction Industry | Pakistan Property Playbook' (YouTube, 2025-06-15)

fact_text: Bakhshi said buyers need a RERA-style law guaranteeing on-time delivery so that their payments are protected.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Budget 2026 is Shaping the Real Estate & Construction Industry | Pakistan Property Playbook' (YouTube, 2025-06-15)

fact_text: Bakhshi said subsidised home financing is needed, as in other countries, and a financing policy was reportedly planned but not yet announced.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Budget 2026 is Shaping the Real Estate & Construction Industry | Pakistan Property Playbook' (YouTube, 2025-06-15)

fact_text: The builders asked for a long-term policy, tax rationalisation, digitisation and lower cost of doing business to make Pakistan regionally competitive.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Budget 2026 is Shaping the Real Estate & Construction Industry | Pakistan Property Playbook' (YouTube, 2025-06-15)
